notes: Shipped competitor bug: a manual pick only propagated to the immediately-next episode and reverted to profile defaults afterward. The resolver applies the persisted series-scoped record directly with no adjacency/recency limitation, so a later item in the group still resolves the pin. langPrefs is deliberately set to a language absent from this item's tracks (fr) so an implementation that dropped the pin would visibly diverge (it would fall back to policy and pick the first-listed track under 'default subtitles' instead of the pinned German track).
